levels.B1: Understands the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters. Writes simple connected text. Gives brief reasons for opinions and plans.
levels.B2: Understands the main ideas of complex texts, including technical discussion in his field. Interacts without strain. Writes clear, detailed text and explains a viewpoint with pros and cons.

no_numbers_note: The CEFR gives no vocabulary sizes and no study hours. The app never derives 'enough words for B1' from a CEFR number.
